title: Face naturality of the concrete coefficient mates
statement: Let $f:X\to T$, $F\in\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$, $U\subseteq T$, $Y=f^{-1}U$, and $V:\mathrm{Fin}(r)\to Y.\mathrm{Opens}$. Let $g:T'\to U$, $g':X'\to X$, $f':X'\to T'$ satisfy $g'f=f'gU.\iota$. Let $W_i$ be opens of $X'$ such that for every increasing tuple $t:\mathrm{Fin}(p+1)\hookrightarrow\mathrm{Fin}(r)$ the intersection $W_t=\bigcap_i W_{t(i)}$ equals $g'^{-1}(Y.\iota(Z_t))$, with $Z_t=\bigcap_i V_{t(i)}$. Use [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-pc-finite-affine-cech-model] and [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex]. Let $q_t$ be the explicit mate of the linear section map of [lem-pc-coefficient-section-map-linear] under the composed tilde/Gamma and two pullback adjunctions. For every face deleting an index $j$, every base open $B\subseteq T'$, and every section of the associated-and-pulled-back coefficient sheaf of $Z_{\mathrm{face}}$ on $B$, applying coefficient restriction then $q_t$ and support identification equals applying $q_{\mathrm{face}}$, support identification, and restriction from $W_{\mathrm{face}}\cap f'^{-1}B$ to $W_t\cap f'^{-1}B$. This is naturality of an explicit construction, with no existence, invertibility or generator assertion.

source.place: Tag 02KE, termwise Cech map; Tag 01I6, Lemma 26.7.1; Tags 0096 and 0097, module adjunction and composition

proof.text:
Restriction of sections from an intersection with a deleted index to the
full intersection commutes with restrictAppIso and with the pullback unit.
Thus the explicitly defined section maps commute with the source restriction
and the support restriction on the target. Take mates under the composed
adjunction. Naturality of the hom equivalence on both sides gives equality of
module morphisms after the coefficient restriction. Evaluate on B and use
naturality of the support identifications. Their equality morphisms and the
inclusions of supports compose to the single inclusion displayed here, by
proof irrelevance in the poset of opens. For empty opens the same identities
hold; for an empty tuple family there is no face to check.
